tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Wikipedia article titles by prefix as the user types a topic, returning matching pages with short description and thumbnail. Use the returned title with get_article_summary or get_article_content to open the best match.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Wikipedia language subdomain, e.g. "en" (usual value).

inputs.name: search
inputs.description: Search text or title prefix, e.g. "Solar System".

inputs.name: thumbnail_size
inputs.description: Desired thumbnail width in pixels, e.g. 330.

tools.name: get_article_summary
tools.description: Get an article's summary: title, short description, intro extract, thumbnail and canonical URLs. The title comes from search_articles (title field) or from get_article_languages for another language.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Wikipedia language subdomain, e.g. "en" (usual value).

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Article title with underscores for spaces, e.g. "Solar_System". From search_articles or get_article_languages.

tools.name: get_article_content
tools.description: Fetch the full readable article as mobile HTML so it can be read. Text size and dark/sepia themes are client-side display settings, not API options. Title comes from search_articles or get_article_languages.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Wikipedia language subdomain of the article, e.g. "en" (usual value).

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Article title with underscores, e.g. "Solar_System" or "Sonnestelsel".

tools.name: get_article_media
tools.description: List the images and media used in an article with captions and source URLs. Title comes from search_articles or get_article_languages.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Wikipedia language subdomain of the article, e.g. "en" (usual value).

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Article title in that language, e.g. "Solar_System".

tools.name: get_article_languages
tools.description: List the other-language versions of an article (language code and translated title). Pass a language code and title from here to get_article_summary or get_article_content to read it in that language.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Language subdomain of the source article, e.g. "en" (usual value).

inputs.name: titles
inputs.description: Article title, e.g. "Solar_System". From search_articles or get_article_summary (titles.canonical).

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Max number of language links to return, e.g. 500.

tools.name: list_wikipedia_languages
tools.description: List all Wikipedia language editions with code, English name and local name, for building a language switcher. Codes are used as lang in other tools.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Wikipedia language subdomain, e.g. "en" (usual value).

tools.name: get_article_info
tools.description: Get page metadata (display title, language, content model, description, thumbnail) for an article title in a given language edition; useful to confirm a translated article exists before opening or saving it. Title comes from get_article_languages.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Language subdomain of the edition to query, a code from list_wikipedia_languages or get_article_languages, e.g. "af".

inputs.name: titles
inputs.description: Article title in that language, e.g. "Sonnestelsel".

inputs.name: thumbnail_size
inputs.description: Desired thumbnail width in pixels, e.g. 330.

tools.name: get_featured_feed
tools.description: Get the Explore feed for a date: today's featured article, most-read articles, picture of the day, news stories, On this day events and Did you know items.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Wikipedia language subdomain, e.g. "en" (usual value).

inputs.name: year
inputs.description: Four-digit year, e.g. "2026".

inputs.name: month
inputs.description: Two-digit month, e.g. "11".

inputs.name: day
inputs.description: Two-digit day of month, e.g. "13".

tools.name: get_on_this_day
tools.description: List historical events that happened on a given month and day, with linked articles.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Wikipedia language subdomain, e.g. "en" (usual value).

inputs.name: month
inputs.description: Two-digit month, e.g. "11".

inputs.name: day
inputs.description: Two-digit day of month, e.g. "13".

tools.name: get_random_articles
tools.description: Get a batch of random articles (up to 40) with intro extract, description and thumbnail, for browsing the Explore feed.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Wikipedia language subdomain, e.g. "en" (usual value).

inputs.name: extract_chars
inputs.description: Max characters of intro extract per article, e.g. 500.

inputs.name: thumbnail_size
inputs.description: Desired thumbnail width in pixels, e.g. 330.
